intro x y hxy
have h0 : 0 ≤ x := Set.Ici.mem_iff.1 (Set.Ici.mem_iff.2 x)
have h1 : 0 ≤ y := Set.Ici.mem_iff.1 (Set.Ici.mem_iff.2 y)
have h2 : x ≠ 0 ∨ y ≠ 0 := or.intro_left (fun h => false) (fun h => false) (by contradiction)
obtain ⟨hx, hy⟩ := hxy
have h3 : x ≠ y := by contrapositive; intro H; rw [H]; exact hx
have h4 : √x + √y < 2 * √(x * y / 2) := by
  have h5 : x * y / 2 = (x * y) / 2 := rfl
  have h6 : √x + √y < 2 * √(x * y / 2) :=
    calc
      √x + √y < 2 * √(x * y / 2) :=
        by {
          rw [mul_div_right]; 
          have h7 : 0 < x * y := mul_pos h0 h1;
          have h8 : 0 < 2 := zero_lt_two;
          have h9 : 0 < x * y / 2 := div_pos h7 h8;
          have h10 : √(x * y / 2) = sqrt (x * y / 2) := rfl;
          have h11 : 2 * √(x * y / 2) = 2 * sqrt (x * y / 2) := rfl;
          have h12 : √x + √y < 2 * √(x * y / 2) :=
            by {
              rw [sqrt_add_lt_sqrt_mul];
              exact ⟨h0, h1, h3, h7, h8, h9⟩
            }
        }
  exact h6
have h7 : √(x * y / 2) < √( (x + y) / 2 ) := by
  have h8 : x * y / 2 < (x + y) / 2 :=
    calc
      x * y / 2 < (x + y) / 2 :=
        by {
          rw [mul_div_right];
          have h9 : 0 < x + y := add_pos h0 h1;
          have h10 : 0 < 2 := zero_lt_two;
          have h11 : x * y < x + y :=
            by {
              have h12 : x * y < x + y :=
                by {
                  have h13 : x * y - x - y < 0 :=
                    by {
                      have h14 : x * y - x - y = (x - 1) * (y - 1) - 1 :=
                        by { rw [sub_add, sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc], ring }
                      have h15 : (x - 1) * (y - 1) - 1 < 0 :=
                        by {
                          have h16 : x - 1 ≤ x := le_refl x
                          have h17 : y - 1 ≤ y := le_refl y
                          have h18 : (x - 1) * (y - 1) ≤ x * y := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h16 h17 h0 h1
                          have h19 : x * y - 1 ≤ x * y := sub_le_self (one_lt_zero.false)
                          have h20 : (x - 1) * (y - 1) - 1 ≤ x * y - 1 := sub_le_sub h18 (le_refl 1)
                          have h21 : x * y - 1 < x * y := sub_lt_self (one_lt_zero.false)
                          have h22 : (x - 1) * (y - 1) - 1 < x * y := lt_trans h20 h21
                          exact h22
                        }
                      exact h14
                    }
                  exact h12
                }
              exact h13
            }
          exact h9
        }
  have h13 : √(x * y / 2) < √( (x + y) / 2 ) :=
    by {
      have h14 : x * y / 2 < (x + y) / 2 := h8
      have h15 : 0 < x * y / 2 := div_pos h7 h8
      have h16 : 0 < (x + y) / 2 := div_pos h9 h10
      exact sqrt_lt_sqrt h14 h15 h16
    }
  exact h13
have h8 : √(x * y / 2) < √( (x + y) / 2 ) := h7
have h9 : √x + √y < 2 * √(x * y / 2) := h4
have h10 : 2 * √(x * y / 2) < 2 * √( (x + y) / 2 ) :=
  by {
    have h11 : √(x * y / 2) < √( (x + y) / 2 ) := h8
    have h12 : 0 < √(x * y / 2) := sqrt_pos h15
    have h13 : 0 < √( (x + y) / 2 ) := sqrt_pos h16
    exact mul_lt_mul h11 h12 h13
  }
have h11 : √x + √y < 2 * √( (x + y) / 2 ) :=
  by {
    have h12 : √x + √y < 2 * √(x * y / 2) := h9
    have h13 : 2 * √(x * y / 2) < 2 * √( (x + y) / 2 ) := h10
